name: MMBench
intro: MMBench 是中英双语的图像多选题基准家族。当前论文 v4/v5 描述 v1.1 的 3,217 道逻辑题；早期论文的 2,974 题与 v1.0 发布文件的 2,948 题属于不同版本边界。评测采用零样本开放式生成、选项抽取与 CircularEval，并按逻辑原题报告总体及 L2/L3 准确率。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Zhejiang University
build_method: 三级能力体系、作者冷启动、学生志愿者扩充、双路模型筛查与人工复核、GPT-4 翻译及人工核验
metric: CircularEval 逻辑题准确率（总体微平均、L2/L3 分组）
eval_feature: 双语对齐, CircularEval, 启发式与 GPT-4-0125 选项抽取
build_method_en: Three-level taxonomy, author seeds, student-volunteer expansion, dual model screening with human review, and GPT-4 translation with human verification
eval_feature_en: Bilingual alignment, CircularEval, heuristic and GPT-4-0125 choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench is a bilingual family of image multiple-choice benchmarks. Paper revisions v4/v5 describe the 3,217-logical-item v1.1 dataset; the 2,974 questions reported by earlier paper revisions and the 2,948 logical items in the v1.0 release files are separate version boundaries. Evaluation uses zero-shot open generation, choice extraction, and CircularEval, then reports overall and L2/L3 logical-item accuracy.
scale_en: v1.1 has 3,217 logical items; DEV 1,292 / TEST 1,925
metric_en: CircularEval logical-item accuracy (overall micro-average and L2/L3 groups)

drawio_review_note: Source audit pins arXiv:2307.06281v5 (PDF SHA-256 3cd9025569600c548d29a987e1cef6bdac8dc07cdeb6bd49ef04690ae80ebd6b) and MMBench repository commit 8eaac9ae42e22eaf42863b218455acd51268ba1c. Paper v4/v5 explicitly calls the 3,217-item dataset MMBench v1.1; v1–v3 state 2,974 questions, while the revised October-2023 v1.0 DEV/TEST files contain 1,164 + 1,784 = 2,948 logical items. The paper defines 2 L1, 6 L2, and 20 L3 abilities, 10–20 author seeds per L3, volunteer expansion (>80% Internet, about 20% public-validation images), and two model-assisted filters followed by human review. Its main text says text-only majority success triggers review, whereas Appendix B names GPT-4, Gemini-Pro, and Qwen-Max and says more than two, effectively 3/3; the diagram preserves that inconsistency. English and GPT-4-translated, human-verified Chinese releases align item identities and answers. Zero-shot open generation is parsed heuristically, then by gpt-4-0125 when unresolved; CircularEval rotates all N choices and requires every pass correct. Current VLMEvalKit report_acc computes a micro mean over logical-item hits overall and within L2/L3 groups, not a macro ability score. Released code retries the judge three times and can then return a random valid choice or Z, a code caveat rather than a paper-wide policy. Openness is partly public because test-label visibility and official-server behavior vary by version, image provenance is mixed, and the repository Apache-2.0 license does not by itself relicense dataset images. Formal publication evidence [site-a11m-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3565×785 (English) and 3565×785 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3563×783 and 3563×783. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
